swatch.newGroup.description: Creates a colour group from existing swatches, new colours or the selected art's colours.

swatch.resetDefaults.description: Restores the default swatches and colour groups of the document's colour mode that are missing, or replaces all swatches with the defaults.

swatch.setSpot.description: Makes a swatch a spot colour (or a process colour again); spot swatches print on their own plate.

swatch.sortByKind.description: Orders the swatches by kind: None, process colours, spot colours, gradients, then patterns.

swatch.spotOptions.description: Sets whether Lab-defined spot colours display and export from their Lab values or their CMYK equivalents.

swatch.ungroup.description: Dissolves a colour group, moving its swatches to the ungrouped list; answers their names.

swatch.unused.description: Answers the names of swatches nothing in the document uses, without changing anything.

symbol.adjust.description: Adjusts symbol instances near points with a symbolism tool: shift, scrunch, size, spin, stain, screen or style.

symbol.breakLink.description: Expands the selected symbol instances into plain art.

symbol.delete.description: Deletes a symbol, expanding its instances (or deleting them).

symbol.duplicate.description: Duplicates a symbol under a new name and answers it.

symbol.edit.description: Breaks the link of the selected instance so its art can be edited; finish with symbol.update.

symbol.list.description: Answers the document's symbols with their instance counts and sizes, and the current symbol.

symbol.new.description: Makes a symbol from the selection and replaces the selection with an instance; answers both.

symbol.place.description: Places an instance of a symbol (default the current one) centred at x, y; answers its id.

symbol.replace.description: Swaps the symbol of the selected instances for another.

symbol.selectInstances.description: Selects every instance of a symbol; answers the count.

symbol.setCurrent.description: Sets the symbol the symbolism tools spray; not an undo step.

symbol.spray.description: Sprays symbol instances along points into a symbol set (or removes them with alt), as the Symbol Sprayer does.

symbol.update.description: Redefines a symbol with the selected art; all its instances update.

text.addFontFiles.description: Copies font files found by text.findFontFiles into the kit's own Fonts folder so they become available.

text.areaOptions.description: Sets area type options of the selected type: frame size, rows, columns, gutter, inset, first baseline, vertical alignment and auto-fit.

text.create.description: Creates point or area type at x, y with text, size, font, colour and alignment options; answers its id. Use text.setText to change existing type.

text.createInPath.description: Puts new type inside a closed path (area type) or along a path (type on a path) with text, font and fit options; answers its id.

text.discardEmpty.description: Removes type object id when it has no characters, dropping the steps that created it when nothing else changed.

text.editRange.description: Replaces bytes start..end of a type object's plain text with insert or styled runs; answers the caret position.

text.findFontFiles.description: Searches a folder for font files matching the document's missing fonts (or given ones) and answers what it found.

text.fitHeadline.description: Tracks the first line of area type so it fills the frame width; answers the tracking used.

text.fontList.description: Answers the font families available to the kit (bundled, added and installed), by their canonical names for text.setStyle.

text.fonts.description: Answers the fonts the document's type uses, with how they resolve (exact, substitute, missing) and missing glyphs.

text.getRange.description: Answers a type object's text (or a byte range of it) with its styled runs and length; the document is unchanged.

text.insertInline.description: Inserts a symbol inline into text at a byte offset, scaled and shifted relative to the font size.

text.missingFonts.description: Answers the fonts the document's type and symbols use that aren't available as named, with what they resolve to.

text.replaceFont.description: Replaces one font (family and optionally style) with another in all text or only the selection; answers runs changed.

text.rescanFonts.description: Rescans the system font folders for fonts installed or removed since start; text in newly available fonts redraws.

text.reshapeArea.description: Moves anchors of an area type frame by dx, dy so the text reflows, as dragging a frame corner does.

text.setFormat.description: Sets character and paragraph formats on type: kerning, baseline shift, scaling, rotation, underline, caps, position, indents, spacing and alignment.

text.setRangeStyle.description: Sets character attributes on a byte range of one type object (default all its text): font, size, leading, tracking, kerning, scale, rotation, fill, stroke and more.

text.setStyle.description: Sets character style on type or a byte range of it: font, style, size, leading, tracking, justification, fill and OpenType features.

text.setText.description: Replaces the contents of type objects id or ids with text, keeping the first run's style.

text.tabs.clear.description: Removes all tab stops from the selected text's paragraphs.

text.tabs.get.description: Answers the tab stops of the first selected text object's paragraph.

text.tabs.set.description: Replaces the tab stops of the selected text's paragraphs with positions, alignments and leaders.

text.thread.create.description: Threads the selected area type and closed paths in stacking order so text flows from one frame to the next; answers the ids.

text.thread.info.description: Answers every text thread in the document as ordered lists of frame ids.

text.thread.releaseSelection.description: Takes the selected frames out of their threads; the story reflows through the rest.

text.thread.remove.description: Breaks the selected frames' threads, each frame keeping the text it shows.

transparency.disableOpacityMask.description: Keeps the opacity masks of the selection or ids but stops applying them.

transparency.editOpacityMask.description: Enters editing of an object's opacity mask art in place, as clicking its mask thumbnail does.

transparency.enableOpacityMask.description: Applies disabled opacity masks of the selection or ids again.

transparency.info.description: Answers the Transparency panel values of ids or the selection: opacity, blend mode, isolation, knockout and the page's isolated-blending and knockout settings.

transparency.linkOpacityMask.description: Links the opacity masks of the selection or ids again so they move with their objects.

transparency.makeOpacityMask.description: Makes the topmost selected object the opacity mask of the others (grouped if several); a single object gets an empty mask and enters mask editing.

transparency.opacityMaskInfo.description: Answers the opacity masks of ids or the selection: whether each clips, is inverted, disabled or linked, and its art.

transparency.releaseOpacityMask.description: Releases the opacity masks of the selection or ids, putting the mask art back above each masked object.

transparency.set.description: Sets opacity, blend mode, isolation and knockout of ids or the selection (or of one appearance item), as the Transparency panel does.

transparency.setOpacityMask.description: Changes the opacity masks of ids or the selection: clipping, inverted, disabled or linked.

transparency.stopEditingOpacityMask.description: Leaves opacity mask editing and returns to editing the object.

transparency.toggleNewMasksClipping.description: Sets (or toggles) whether new opacity masks clip by default; answers the setting.

transparency.toggleNewMasksInverted.description: Sets (or toggles) whether new opacity masks are inverted by default; answers the setting.

transparency.togglePageIsolatedBlending.description: Sets (or toggles) whether the page is an isolated group, so top-level blend modes don't blend with what is under the page; answers the setting.

transparency.togglePageKnockoutGroup.description: Sets (or toggles) whether the page is a knockout group, so layers hide what they cover; answers the setting.

transparency.unlinkOpacityMask.description: Unlinks the opacity masks of the selection or ids so the objects move without their masks.

transparency.viewOpacityMask.description: Shows only an object's opacity mask on the canvas as greyscale coverage (or turns that off).

type.changeCase.description: Changes the case of the selected text or ids to upper, lower, title or sentence case.

type.convertToAreaType.description: Converts point type to area type framed by its current bounds; answers the ids.

type.convertToPointType.description: Converts area type to point type, turning soft wraps into line breaks; answers the ids.

type.createOutlines.description: Converts the selected text into groups of compound paths, one per glyph; the text is no longer editable.

type.fillPlaceholder.description: Replaces the selected text with placeholder text (area type fills its frame).

type.fitHeadline.description: Tracks the first line of the selected area type so it fills the frame width; answers the tracking.

type.insert.description: Inserts a special character (bullet, dash, quote, space, hyphen or symbol) at the Type tool's caret.

type.orientation.horizontal.description: Sets the selected or given type objects to horizontal writing.

type.orientation.vertical.description: Sets the selected or given type objects to vertical writing.

type.pathOptions.description: Sets type-on-a-path options: start and end brackets, flip, effect (rainbow, skew, ribbon, stair step, gravity), alignment and spacing.

type.size.decrease.description: Decreases the selected text's font size by a number of preference steps.

type.size.increase.description: Increases the selected text's font size by a number of preference steps.

type.smartPunctuation.description: Replaces straight quotes, double hyphens and triple dots with typographic quotes, dashes and ellipses in the selection or document.

type.step.description: Steps a type attribute (size, leading, tracking, kerning, baseline shift) up or down by the preference increments.

variable.bind.description: Binds objects (default the selection) to a variable; text variables need type.

variable.define.description: Defines a text or visibility variable for data-driven graphics.

variable.delete.description: Deletes variables with their bindings and dataset values (default the highlighted one).

variable.highlight.description: Highlights one row in the Variables panel, which its Delete and Options act on; not an undo step.

variable.list.description: Answers the document's variables with their kinds and how many objects each is bound to.

variable.makeTextDynamic.description: Defines a text variable over the selected type, named after it and bound to it.

variable.makeVisibilityDynamic.description: Defines a visibility variable over the selection, named after it and bound to it.

variable.rename.description: Renames a variable along with its bindings and dataset values.

variable.unbind.description: Removes variable bindings from objects (default the selection): one variable or all of them.

view.drawMode.description: Sets where new objects go: drawn normally, behind the selection, or inside the one selected path (no mode cycles through them).

view.guides.clear.description: Deletes all ruler guides and guide paths; answers how many.

view.guides.lock.description: Locks, unlocks or toggles guides for the session; answers the lock state.

view.guides.make.description: Turns the selected paths into guides; answers how many.

view.guides.release.description: Turns the selected guides (or all guide paths) back into ordinary paths; answers how many.

view.overprintPreview.description: Turns Overprint Preview on, off or toggles it; answers the proof state.

view.printTiling.description: Shows, hides or toggles the print pages on the canvas; answers the setting.

view.proofColors.description: Turns soft-proofing of colours on, off or toggles it; answers the proof state.

view.proofSetup.description: Sets the soft-proof target (a CMYK profile or a colour-blindness simulation), intent and paper simulation; answers the proof state.

view.saved.edit.description: Renames or deletes a saved view; without params answers the views.

view.saved.list.description: Answers the document's saved views with their centre, zoom and rotation.

view.saved.new.description: Saves a named view (centre, zoom, rotation); answers its name and index.

view.separationsPreview.description: Shows chosen ink plates in Separations Preview (one plate as greyscale coverage); answers the plates.

view.slices.hide.description: Hides, shows or toggles slices on the canvas (session view state).

view.slices.lock.description: Locks, unlocks or toggles slices so the Slice Selection tool can't change them.

view.transparencyGrid.description: Shows, hides or toggles the transparency grid behind the document's artboards; answers the setting.

webExport.presets.delete.description: Deletes a saved Save for Web preset.

webExport.presets.list.description: Answers the Save for Web presets, built-in and saved, with their settings.

webExport.presets.save.description: Creates or changes a saved Save for Web preset.

webExport.settings.description: Reads or changes the remembered Save for Web settings.
